questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated
questions.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; title: 'Cell Maps for Artificial Intelligence (CM4AI)'; description: ~1500-char narrative; keywords: 26 entries; license_and_use_terms: detailed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 block
questions.quality_note: All five mandatory fields present with substantive, meaningful content (100% populated).

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.evidence: description spans lines 10-27 (~1500 chars); motivation captured in purposes (4 entries, each 200-400 chars, e.g. cm4ai:purpose:1)
questions.quality_note: Narrative fields far exceed the 200-char threshold and provide rich, specific context.

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.evidence: 26 unique keywords including 'Cell Maps', 'Spatial Proteomics', 'CRISPR Perturbation', 'AP-MS', 'SEC-MS', 'RO-Crate', 'FAIRSCAPE', 'Visible Neural Networks', 'MDA-MB-468', 'KOLF2.1J'
questions.quality_note: 26 keywords span methods, modalities, cell lines, and frameworks, maximizing discoverability.

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of files and file type diversity
questions.evidence: distribution_formats lists 5 distinct mechanisms/formats: RO-Crate/ZIP+JSON-LD (cm4ai:format:1), MassIVE mass-spec data (format:2), NCBI SRA sequence data (format:3), NDEx network/CX cell maps (format:4), UVA Dataverse archive (format:5); 4 distributions with media_type application/zip
questions.quality_note: Data spans multimodal file types (imaging, mass spectrometry, sequence, network) across multiple repositories.

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or dimensional/sample-count metadata
questions.evidence: Sample/dimension counts present: 'over 1,000 protein complexes', 'over 700 complexes in iPSCs', '11,739 targeted genes', '100 chromatin regulators', '6 guide RNAs per gene', 'SEC-MS identified 72/100 chromatin modifiers', '10 layers of depth'
questions.quality_note: Pass on sample/dimensional counts; note that explicit byte-level file sizes (MB/GB) and array shapes are not stated.

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.evidence: doi: 10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; page: https://www.cm4ai.org; download_url: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; cell-line RRIDs (RRID:CVCL_0419, RRID:CVCL_B5P3)
questions.quality_note: Multiple persistent identifiers present: dataset DOI, resolvable URLs, and RRIDs.

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, sponsors
questions.evidence: funders: 'NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program... grant 1OT2OD032742-01... and 5U54HG012513-02... Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008... FY 2025 funding: $5,289,382... Additional funding from the Frederick Thomas Fund of the University of Virginia'
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive: named agency, two award numbers, opportunity number, project dates, dollar amounts, and additional sponsor.

FDA Regulated: No'; sensitive_elements documents donor metadata handling
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive ethics coverage appropriate to the data type: de-identification method, ethical sourcing, governance oversight. Formal IRB is genuinely N/A (non-human-subjects cell-line data), and the datasheet explains why.

questions.name: Access Requirements Documentation
questions.score_label: License + Data Use Agreement + platform access description
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with attribution/citation requirements; 'Commercial use requires separate license negotiation'; 'A Data Access Committee (led by Jillian Parker) supervises ethical matters'; KOLF2.1J 'available... via a simple MTA'; access via Dataverse, NDEx, MassIVE, SRA
questions.quality_note: License type, use conditions, MTA, Data Access Committee, and multiple access platforms all specified.

questions.name: Interoperability and Standardization
questions.evidence: conforms_to: https://w3id.org/bridge2ai/data-sheets-schema/core-schema; conforms_to_class: CoreDataset; formats RO-Crate/JSON-LD with Schema.org and EVI vocabularies; ontology mapping to Gene Ontology, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, NCI Thesaurus, CHEBI, EFO, Cell Ontology
questions.quality_note: Standard packaging formats plus explicit schema conformance and rich ontology/controlled-vocabulary mapping.

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.score_label: Comprehensive list with versions or URLs
questions.evidence: MuSIC pipeline, node2vec, Human Protein Atlas deep-learning model, contrastive deep learning, Cytoscape multiscale community detection, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, Integrative Modeling Platform (IMP) version 2.18, Python Modeling Interface, 10x Genomics 3'HT kit; URLs at fairscape.github.io and integrativemodeling.org
questions.quality_note: Extensive tool inventory with a pinned version (IMP 2.18) and resolvable URLs; only IMP is version-pinned.

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.description: Completeness of acquisition and procedural detail
questions.evidence: 4 collection_mechanisms + 4 acquisition_methods with specifics: 'Automated fixation and permeabilization protocols using pipetting robot'; four-channel confocal imaging (DAPI/calreticulin/tubulin/protein-of-interest); '17 genes endogenously tagged... under three conditions'; '10x Genomics 3'HT kit'; lab attributions (Lundberg Lab Stanford, Krogan Lab UCSF)
questions.quality_note: Highly detailed acquisition and processing protocols per modality; participant recruitment is N/A for cell-line data.

questions.name: Version History Documentation
questions.score_label: ≥2 versions with change summaries and release dates
questions.evidence: 4 dated distributions with change summaries: V1.4 March 2025 (B35XWX), V2.1 June 2025 (F3TD5R, 'adds RGB IF images... SEC-MS for MDA-MB-468'), October 2025 (K7TGEM, 'adds Perturb-seq for MDA-MB-468'); updates field narrates the release timeline through Nov 2026; version: '2.1'
questions.quality_note: Four dated releases with explicit per-release change summaries.

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.score_label: Multiple references and dataset DOI cross-links
questions.evidence: Nature: Schaffer LV, Hu M, et al. doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3; bioRxiv preprint doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311; Perturbation Cell Atlas bioRxiv doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734, PMCID PMC11580897; cross-linked with dataset DOI 10.18130/V3/DXWOS5

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.evidence: instances: MDA-MB-468 'from a metastatic site... of a 51-year-old black female'; KOLF2.1J 'derived from a healthy male Northern European donor'; 7 subpopulations (untreated/paclitaxel/vorinostat; undifferentiated/neurons/NPCs/cardiomyocytes); sampling_strategies enumerates cell-line selection criteria
questions.quality_note: Donor demographics (age/sex/ancestry) and seven treatment/differentiation subgroups documented; traditional human-subject inclusion/exclusion criteria are N/A for de-identified cell lines.

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.evidence: page: https://www.cm4ai.org; download_url and multiple DOI URLs (DXWOS5, B35XWX, F3TD5R, K7TGEM); 13 external_resources with persistent links (NIH RePORTER, NDEx, FAIRSCAPE, IMP)
questions.quality_note: Numerous persistent, resolvable URLs and DOIs present.

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.evidence: DOI landing pages resolving to human/machine-readable RO-Crate pages; UVA Dataverse (LibraData) archive; NDEx web/Cytoscape/ndex2 access; MassIVE and NCBI SRA depositions; KOLF2.1J via MTA; Data Access Committee for commercial licensing
questions.quality_note: Complete, multi-platform access path with policy and mechanism for each data type.

questions.name: Reusability (License Clarity)
questions.evidence: license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with URL; explicit attribution and citation requirements; non-commercial/share-alike terms; commercial-use path via separate negotiation with named copyright holders (UCSD/Stanford/UCSF)
questions.quality_note: License and reuse conditions are unambiguous, including commercial-use handling.

questions.name: Data Integrity and Provenance
questions.evidence: FAIRSCAPE 'computes end-to-end provenance entailments using EVI Evidence Graph Ontology'; ARK persistent identifiers; RO-Crates 'with provenance graphs'; updates field with dated release history; retention_limit describes long-term preservation in UVA LibraData
questions.quality_note: Structured, machine-readable provenance (EVI/ARK) plus dated version history and preservation commitment.

questions.name: Interlinking Across Platforms
questions.evidence: external_resources link across NDEx, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, UVA Dataverse, NIH RePORTER, FAIRSCAPE, IMP, Bridge2AI program, NIH CFDE; distribution_formats reference the same platforms
questions.quality_note: Extensive verified cross-platform interlinking across repositories and program resources.

strengths: Complete structural metadata: all mandatory fields populated with substantive content and 26 diverse keywords
Exceptional funding documentation with two NIH award numbers, opportunity number, project dates, and dollar amounts
Strong FAIR compliance: persistent DOIs/ARKs, FAIRSCAPE/EVI machine-readable provenance, and RO-Crate/JSON-LD packaging with Schema.org and rich ontology mapping
Detailed multimodal collection and preprocessing protocols (IF imaging, AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPR/Perturb-seq, MuSIC integration) with tool and lab attributions
Well-documented version history: four dated beta releases with explicit change summaries plus a preservation commitment in UVA LibraData
Three DOI-linked publications (including the 2025 Nature paper) cross-referenced with the dataset DOI
Extensive cross-platform interlinking (NDEx, MassIVE, SRA, Dataverse, NIH RePORTER, FAIRSCAPE, CFDE)
weaknesses: No explicit byte-level file sizes (MB/GB) or array-shape dimensions; dimensional information is conveyed only as sample/entity counts
Software tools are comprehensively listed but only the Integrative Modeling Platform (v2.18) is version-pinned; node2vec, MuSIC, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, and Cytoscape lack version numbers
No formal IRB reference (genuinely inapplicable here given de-identified commercial cell lines, but noted for completeness)
Human-subject characterization relies on cell-line donor demographics rather than participant inclusion/exclusion criteria
recommendations: Add per-distribution file sizes and, where meaningful, array/matrix dimensions (e.g., IF image resolution, single-cell matrix shape) to the distribution or file metadata
Pin version numbers for all preprocessing tools (node2vec, MuSIC pipeline, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, Cytoscape) alongside the existing IMP 2.18 reference
Add direct persistent URLs/accessions for the MassIVE and NCBI SRA depositions (resources 11-12 currently name the repository without a link)
Consider a brief explicit statement that IRB review is not applicable and why, to make the ethics rationale unambiguous for automated FAIR assessors
